As Credit Suisse Group (CS) Market Valuation Declined, Eaton Vance Management Trimmed Position by $1.37 Million; Sigma Investment Counselors Has Cut Its Position in Apple (AAPL) as Stock Value Declined 
March 31, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson 
Eaton Vance Management decreased its stake in Credit Suisse Group (CS) by 4.96% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Eaton Vance Management sold 80,616 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.85% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.54M shares of the investment bankers and brokers and service company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $27.55M, down from 1.62M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Eaton Vance Management who had been investing in Credit Suisse Group for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $43.36 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.27% or $0.21   $16.79. About 2.28M shares traded. Credit Suisse Group AG (NYSE:CS) has risen 14.88%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 3.33% the S&P500. 
Sigma Investment Counselors Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 10.14% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sigma Investment Counselors Inc sold 4,697 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 41,623 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.04M, down from 46,320 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sigma Investment Counselors Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $851.32 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.78% or $1.3   $167.78. About 38.40M shares traded or 1.81% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.

The firm has “Underweight” rating by JP Morgan given on Monday, June 27. JP Morgan upgraded the shares of CS in report on Thursday, December 8 to “Overweight” rating. The stock has “Sell” rating by Barclays Capital on Tuesday, January 16. The stock of Credit Suisse Group AG (NYSE:CS) earned “Buy” rating by Societe Generale on Tuesday, September 12. UBS upgraded the shares of CS in report on Thursday, May 19 to “Buy” rating. The company was downgraded on Thursday, June 9 by Barclays Capital. Morgan Stanley maintained Credit Suisse Group AG (NYSE:CS) on Tuesday, June 20 with “Buy” rating. The stock of Credit Suisse Group AG (NYSE:CS) earned “Neutral” rating by Macquarie Research on Wednesday, November 15. Deutsche Bank upgraded the stock to “Buy” rating in Monday, June 19 report. 
Eaton Vance Management, which manages about $88.88 billion and $41.30 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Portland Gen Elec Co (NYSE:POR) by 8,004 shares to 88,912 shares, valued at $4.05 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Tempur Sealy Intl Inc (NYSE:TPX) by 141,300 shares in the quarter, for a total of 228,498 shares, and has risen its stake in Cdk Global Inc (NASDAQ:CDK).

(NASDAQ:AAPL) on Friday, January 5. $8.79 million worth of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) was sold by SCHILLER PHILIP W on Tuesday, October 3. 
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on May, 1. They expect $2.71 EPS, up 29.05% or $0.61 from last year’s $2.1 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $13.75 billion for 15.48 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.33% negative EPS growth.
